**Finding submitted: deviation on Section 15 (p0080).**

- **What the document does:** Section 15 is the sole assignment provision. It prohibits assignment by either party without the other's prior written approval, with a mutual exception only for assignment to a "financially responsible affiliate". There is no change-of-control provision anywhere, and no Vendor termination trigger on our change of control.
- **Why it fails fallback:** no successor right at all (no merger/acquisition/asset-sale carve-out and no successor-with-notice construct) and no reasonableness standard on consent; the retained no-consent affiliate exception is also inconsistent with a fallback requiring consent for every non-successor assignment.
- **Target chosen:** preferred, since reaching fallback would require stripping our own affiliate assignment right.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** one surgical replace making the consent requirement one-way on TrueLink (not unreasonably withheld, never to a Client competitor), plus one short inserted sentence giving Client affiliate/successor assignment without approval and confirming no TrueLink termination right on our change of control.
